title: Scheduling Desk Rules: Which Self-Pay Visit Package a Visit Is Drawn From
content:
**Rule.** When a patient holds two active Self-Pay Visit Packages, an attended or forfeited visit is drawn from the package with the earlier expiry date; when both expire the same day, it is drawn from the one purchased first. A package visit is never split across two packages: a visit drawing more visits than remain on the first package is drawn in full from the second.

**The rule broken into its parts**

1. *Applies to:* attended visits paid from a package and visits forfeited from a package, where the patient holds two active packages.
2. *First package:* the one with the earlier expiry date; on equal expiry dates, the one with the earlier purchase.
3. *No splitting:* where the visit draws more package visits than the first package still has, the whole draw comes from the second package.

**Hypothetical cases**

| Package A | Package B | Visit | Drawn from |
|---|---|---|---|
| active, expires earlier, 3 visits left | active, expires later | draws 1 visit | A |
| active, expires the same day, bought first | active, expires the same day, bought later | draws 1 visit | A |
| active, expires earlier, 1 visit left | active, expires later, 6 visits left | draws 2 visits | B, both visits |
| active, expires earlier, 2 visits left | active, expires later | draws 2 visits | A |
